name: legacy-stabilizer
description: Assess and stabilize polyrepos spanning AngularJS 1.x, Angular 17 (NX 17.3.x), and React 19 (Webpack 5 Module Federation MFEs), Java 21 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 & 3.5 / Hibernate / Maven 3.8+, Oracle 19c and AlloyDB (PostgreSQL), SOLR 9.x, and Redis 7.2: map architecture, validate engineering and performance risks with evidence, produce a ranked remediation plan, and emit a SPEC_DRIVEN_BRIEF for spec-driven AI frameworks (BMad, Spec Kit). Assessment-first; remediation is opt-in and authorization-gated. Not a security tool.
